verdict.rationale: Mixpanel's core product is self-serve funnels and retention/drop-off analysis (mixpanel-docs-2, mixpanel-docs-3, mixpanel-docs-16), plus Session Replay explicitly positioned to explain 'why customers drop off' without needing an analyst (mixpanel-docs-4, mixpanel-docs-23, mixpanel-docs-28), and community praise confirms non-analysts (PMs) generating custom funnel/flow reports quickly (mixpanel-comm-12, mixpanel-comm-15). Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation specifically of a founder (not just PM) doing this unaided, and no case study showing an actual activation-funnel diagnosis end-to-end.
